question: Is one terminal marked-loop response state enough to reopen a nonempty and unique generic-Q affine/Gram/source direction at widths three and four?

state_space.ordinary: V_w is the rational span of circular noncrossing connectivity states in repository order
state_space.mark: Add exactly one state mu. It records one terminal singleton-loop response after all marked connectivity outcomes have been collapsed to their endpoint amplitude.
state_space.filtration: The mark line Q*mu is invariant. Intertwiners and their Q velocities may map ordinary states into mu but may not feed mu back into V_w.
state_space.boundary: This is the smallest one-mark endpoint quotient, not the full rooted-connectivity module and not an arbitrary extra matrix block.

generic_Q_action.ordinary_detach: D_i(Q)=D_i(1)+(Q-1)P_i, where P_i projects states in which site i is already singleton
generic_Q_action.mark_emission: ell_i(pi)=1 exactly when site i is singleton
generic_Q_action.first_jet: At Q=1+epsilon, D_bar_i=D_bar_i0+epsilon D_bar_i1 with D_bar_i0=diag(D_i(1),1) and D_bar_i1=[[P_i,0],[ell_i,0]].
generic_Q_action.physical_meaning: The ordinary Q loop weight is retained, while its first insertion is also exposed as one terminal mark. Subsequent marked histories are deliberately collapsed.

gram.marked_column: g(Q)_pi=d/dQ G(Q)_(pi,s0)=b(pi) Q^{b(pi)-1}, where s0 is all-singleton
gram.first_jet: G_bar0 has top-left all ones and marked column b(pi); G_bar1 has top-left b(pi vee sigma) and marked column b(pi)(b(pi)-1)
gram.compatibility: For a radical basis B require B^T(G_bar1 X0-X0^T G_bar1)B=0. The velocity terms vanish on ker(G_bar0), but D_bar_i1 must act nontrivially on R_bar for the mark to count as a genuine Q-sensitive extension.

endpoint_and_source.endpoint_normalization: Each of U,K,M is fixed by X0 and annihilates V. These covectors span the row space of G_bar0 and therefore make R_bar invariant.
endpoint_and_source.source_normalization: X0 fixes S and mu; V kills both.

affine_jet_equations.order_zero: X0 A_i0=B_i0 X0 for joins, translation and detach, with the target site shifted by one
affine_jet_equations.velocity: V A_i0+X0 A_i1=B_i0 V+B_i1 X0; joins and translation have zero first coefficient
affine_jet_equations.mark_filtration: The V_w components of X0*mu and V*mu vanish

analysis_ladder: marked generic-Q affine Hom jet plus mark filtration
plus extended first-jet radical Gram self-adjointness
plus ordinary and marked source normalization

decision_rule.one_mark_unique: The final affine system is consistent with tangent dimension zero.
decision_rule.one_mark_nonunique: The final affine system is consistent with positive tangent dimension.
decision_rule.one_mark_insufficient: The final affine system is inconsistent.
decision_rule.genuine_velocity_gate: At least one D_bar_i1 has nonzero rank from R_bar into the mark coordinate.

lower_bound_if_empty.rule: After endpoint normalization, restrict the canonical Gram skew residual to R_bar. A skew form of rank 2r needs codimension at least r to vanish on a subspace. In the declared scalar endpoint-mark family, each additional independent mark can add at most one new ordinary endpoint covector, so at least r further marks are required.
lower_bound_if_empty.boundary: This is a lower bound within scalar endpoint-mark quotients, not for arbitrary marked connectivity modules.

outputs.exact_dimensions: Affine tangent dimension or inconsistency at every ladder stage
outputs.mark_gate: Rank of the mark row of D_bar_i1 restricted to R_bar
outputs.certificate: A rational particular solution/basis when nonempty, or left-null inconsistency witness at the first empty restriction
outputs.minimum_next: If empty, residual-rank lower bound on further scalar endpoint marks

claim_boundary: Exact rational first-jet algebra only at widths three and four.
The one-mark state is a terminal response quotient; it does not retain marked-cluster geometry after emission.
No continuum LCFT, physical transfer matrix, or formal-semigroup K identification is made.
Failure would motivate the smallest higher marked quotient allowed by the exact skew-rank lower bound, not an unrestricted matrix extension.
